Our warm, relatively shallow and protected waters make an ideal location for the humpbacks to mate and give birth to their calves. blurb: Sail Maui offers sailing tours on catamarans carrying 25-49 guests, focusing on performance sailing with trade winds and open water. Tours include snorkeling at Molokini crater and along the Lāna‘i and West Maui coasts, whale watching, and sunset sails. Guests enjoy a personal experience with attentive crew and opportunities to see marine life and coastal views.

faq.q: Do you have snorkel gear on board?
faq.a: Yes. We provide snorkel gear and will fit you for correct size. We also have a few optical masks on board, so let us know if you require one and we’ll do our best to accommodate you. If you wish to bring your own gear you are more than welcome.

quotes.author: Patti Kinkade • Google
quotes.text: Went on a snorkel Molokini tour today and loved every minute of it! From the captain to the crew & food, nothing could have been better! Captain Brandon was great at navigating the waters and making sure we saw our fair share of whales! AJ and Joey were awesome at hoisting the sails, making sure we had drinks/food and conversing with each of the passengers! We appreciated them sharing their knowledge of whales and the island of Maui & surrounding islands. The Captain and crew made for such an enjoyable time in and out of the water and making sure our safety came first! Definitely book your tour with Sail Maui, you won’t be disappointed! Sure glad we did! Thanks for the adventure!! Mahalo!

quotes.author: Sofya Noskova • Google
quotes.text: I joined the Golden Hour Whale Watch tour in Lahaina with this wonderful team, and it was an outstanding experience from start to finish. The catamaran was beautiful, clean, and very comfortable. The crew was friendly, attentive, and genuinely caring throughout the trip. They shared fascinating facts about the whales, which made the experience even more meaningful. We were fortunate to spot these incredible creatures and felt truly honored to witness them in their natural habitat. The snacks were tasty, the music on board created a great atmosphere, and everything was perfectly organized and on time. It was an unforgettable experience and a lifelong memory. Highly recommended!

quotes.author: Steve C • TripAdvisor
quotes.text: So happy to join this cruise operating out of Lahaina so that we could support the local rebuilding efforts. The catamaran was perfect and the crew of Jess, Braxton and Chase made the excursion fun, informative and relaxing. When they put up the sails, serenity immediately set in. The small group also made it special so that we got to meet and talk with several people. Looking forward to coming back for some of their other tours.

quotes.author: Rayleen Crampton • Google
quotes.text: OMG!! Big thank you to Chase, AJ, and Shannon!! What a trip!! Lana’i Coast Snorkel gave us fish, turtles and whales but the level of care and service this crews gave us was above and beyond. My husband does not swim and they helped/made that snorkel happen, twice!! Unbelievable!! It is the best choice we made on Maui
